fields.description: What each network would refuse, filled in on every save. It must be empty before the post can be queued: a problem found here is one nobody finds in public.

fields.description: The headline of the link's preview. LinkedIn does not read the page, so a link post there needs this.
fields.label: Link Title

fields.description: Used only when the post goes to a YouTube channel. The post text becomes the video's description.
fields.label: YouTube

fields.description: The video's public title on YouTube (the post's Title above is only for finding it in ERPNext). Up to 100 characters, no < or >.
fields.label: Video Title

fields.description: Comma-separated. YouTube allows 500 characters in all.
fields.label: Tags

fields.description: A JPEG or PNG image, ideally 1280x720. Custom thumbnails need a verified YouTube channel; if YouTube refuses it, the video still publishes.
fields.label: Thumbnail

fields.description: Add the video to this playlist (the ID from the playlist's URL, list=...).
fields.label: Playlist ID
